page.layout: One page of text in a single column, with marginal notes in the left and right margins. Left margin: the year numbers and the abbreviated running head "An.M." at the top. Right margin: the line numbers 5, 10, 15, 20, 25, 30, 35. Below the last line: the catchword "mue-". Edge fragments of the neighbouring page at the far left are not transcribed.

main_text.l: In his annis viginti duobus non numerari de-
bent anni duodeviginti, quibus Israëlitæ subiecti
fuerunt Ammonitis & Philistæis: sed sunt seor-
sim computandi, hoc modo,
Interregnum Philistæorum & Ammonitarum
quintâ seruitute.Iud.10.v.8. fuit annorum 18. At-
que hi sunt 18 anni, quos supraadan.M.2517.ex-
cepimus.
Iephthe, ex tribu Manasse, an.6.Iud.12.v.7.
Ebzan, ex tribu Iudâ, an.7.Iud.12.v.9.
Elon, ex tribu Zabulon, annos 10.Iud.12.v.11.
Abdon, ex tribu Ephraim, annos 8.Iud.12.v.14.
Samson, annos 20.Iud.16.v.31. Anni quadragin-
tâ, quibus Israëlitæ Philistinis seruisse dicuntur,
Iud.13. numerandi sunt hunc in modum. Integris
20 annis, quibus Samson iudicauit, seruierunt.
Reliqui 20 anni pertinent ad tempora, quibus
Eli populum gubernauit. Neque tamen est, quòd
ideo Samsonem cū Andreâ Masio expungamus
è numero Iudicum. Nam Scriptura non dicit de
Samsone, quòd populum ab hostibus liberaue-
rit, sicut de aliis iudicibus dicit: sed solùm, quòd
praefuerit summæ rerum, in statu scilicet reipub.
turbato.
Eli, de tribu Leui, praefuit annos 40. 1.Sam.4.
Samuel circa hoc tempus nascitur. Obit enim
septuagenarius, anno M.2888.1.Sam.25.
Samuel duodecim annorum accipit diuinam
vocationem.1.Sam.3.
Eli frangit ceruicem, accepto tristi nuntio de
arcâ Domini captâ. 1.Sam.4.v.15.
Samuel, è tribu Leui, praefuit annos 40. compu-
tatis annis regni Saulis. Actor.13.verf.21. Iosephus
tribuit Samueli soli post obitum Eli annos 12,
& ei vnà cum Saule annos 18, & Sauli post Samue-

page.notes: The catchword "mue-" is at the lower right and is uncertain; it may read differently. "Ebzan" is read as printed; the first letters may be a ligature and are not fully certain. The left-margin year numbers and right-margin line numbers are recorded as notes beside their lines. The "An.M." marginal label is recorded as a note. Edge fragments of the neighbouring page at the far left were left out.
